title: Strava Activity
description: Represents a workout activity recorded on Strava. Activities capture workout data including GPS routes, performance metrics, and social interactions for running, cycling, and 200+ other sport types.

id.description: The unique identifier of the activity

distance.description: The distance of the activity in meters

moving_time.description: The activity's moving time in seconds

elapsed_time.description: The activity's elapsed time in seconds

total_elevation_gain.description: The activity's total elevation gain in meters

type.description: The type of activity (e.g., Run, Ride, Swim, Walk, Hike, VirtualRide)

sport_type.description: The sport type of the activity (Strava v3.5+)

start_date.description: The time at which the activity was started (UTC ISO 8601)

start_date_local.description: The time at which the activity was started in local time

timezone.description: The timezone of the activity (e.g., America/New_York)

achievement_count.description: The number of achievements gained during the activity

kudos_count.description: The number of kudos given to the activity

comment_count.description: The number of comments for the activity

trainer.description: Whether the activity was recorded on a stationary trainer

commute.description: Whether the activity was a commute

manual.description: Whether the activity was manually entered

average_speed.description: The activity's average speed in meters per second

max_speed.description: The activity's max speed in meters per second

average_cadence.description: The activity's average cadence in RPM

weighted_average_watts.description: The activity's normalized power in watts (cycling)

kilojoules.description: The total work done in kilojoules (cycling)

average_heartrate.description: The average heart rate in BPM

max_heartrate.description: The maximum heart rate in BPM
